sentences.en: The United States is undergoing one of the biggest changes to its social safety net in recent history, with huge numbers of people dropping out of the government's
sentences.zh: 美国正在经历近代史上社会安全网最大的变革之一，大量民众退出了政府的

sentences.en: food assistance program.
sentences.zh: 食品援助计划。

sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的情况最为剧烈。

sentences.en: For some reason or another, my food stamps application keeps getting lost, you know, quote-unquote loSt.

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jason DeParle explains why so many people there are suddenly losing access to this key benefit
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰森·德帕尔将解释为什么那里有这么多人突然失去了这项关键福利的获取资格，

sentences.en: and the implications all this could have for the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 以及这一切可能对全国产生的影响。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jason, we want to talk to you today about these drastic changes that have been made to the food stamp program known as SNAP.
sentences.zh: 杰森，我们今天想和你谈谈针对SNAP食品券计划所做的这些剧烈改革。

sentences.en: When Trump's big, beautiful bill passed about a year ago, we understood that Republicans were planning to pay for it by making cuts to the government's welfare prograMs.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普那项“宏大而美好”的法案在大约一年前通过时，我们明白共和党人计划通过削减政府福利项目来为此买单。

sentences.en: You have been following that story all the way to Arizona.
sentences.zh: 你一直追踪着这个故事，直到亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: So just walk me through why you went there.
sentences.zh: 那么，请带我了解一下你为什么去那里。

sentences.en: Arizona is the place in the country that's had the largest reduction in food stamps since the passage of the big, beautiful bill.
sentences.zh: 自那项“宏大而美好”的法案通过以来，亚利桑那州是全国食品券削减幅度最大的地方。

sentences.en: The rolls there have fallen in half.
sentences.zh: 那里的受益人数减少了一半。

sentences.en: 450,000 people have lost nutrition aid there.
sentences.zh: 45万人失去了营养援助。

sentences.en: That's just a huge number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: Yes, it includes more than 100,000 children as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中还包括超过10万名儿童。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why has the drop-off been so steep?
sentences.zh: 为什么下降得如此剧烈？

sentences.en: The law imposed dramatic changes in the SNAP program, but mostly deferred those changes until after the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 该法律对SNAP计划进行了重大改革，但大部分改革推迟到了中期选举之后。

sentences.en: Arizona was the state that moved most aggressively to make changes.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州是采取行动最激进的州。

sentences.en: And Jason, just remind us what those changes actually were and the argument that Republicans made for why they needed to implement them.
sentences.zh: 杰森，提醒我们一下，这些改革究竟是什么，以及共和党人为什么要实施这些改革的理由。

sentences.en: Republicans saw SNAP as a bloated program.
sentences.zh: 共和党人认为SNAP是一个臃肿的计划。

sentences.en: It had more than doubled in size since 2000.
sentences.zh: 自2000年以来，它的规模翻了一番多。

sentences.en: About one in eight Americans get SNAP, and its annual cost had exceeded $100 billion.
sentences.zh: 大约八分之一的美国人领取SNAP，其年度成本已超过1000亿美元。

sentences.en: They thought it needed reining in.
sentences.zh: 他们认为需要对其进行限制。

sentences.en: They thought it served as a work disincentive.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这起到了抑制工作积极性的作用。

sentences.en: They thought that offering people nutrition aid persuaded some not to work or not to work as much as they could.
sentences.zh: 他们认为提供营养援助会劝阻一些人不去工作，或者不去尽其所能地工作。

sentences.en: They were concerned that some people committed fraud to get on it.
sentences.zh: 他们担心有些人为了获得福利而进行欺诈。

sentences.en: But those were all longstanding concerns.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是长期存在的担忧。

sentences.en: What really drove the changes last year in Congress was the need for money to finance President Trump's tax cuts, which I think it's worth remembering largely went to the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 去年国会改革的真正驱动力是需要资金来资助特朗普总统的减税政策，我认为值得记住的是，这些减税主要惠及了富人。

sentences.en: The reason they did what they did when they did it was because they wanted money for President Trump's tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以在那个时候做这些事，是因为他们想要钱来资助特朗普总统的减税政策。

sentences.en: And how do they go about shrinking the program?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何着手缩减该计划的？

sentences.en: What do they actually do?
sentences.zh: 他们实际上做了什么？

sentences.en: The thing that's gotten the most attention and it's probably the easiest to understand is that they expanded work requirements.
sentences.zh: 最受关注、也最容易理解的一点是，他们扩大了工作要求。

sentences.en: More people have to work in order to qualify for benefits.
sentences.zh: 更多人必须工作才能获得福利资格。

sentences.en: It used to be the people 55 and older were exempt.
sentences.zh: 过去55岁及以上的人是可以豁免的。

sentences.en: Now they've expanded that up to age 65.
sentences.zh: 现在他们将这一年龄限制扩大到了65岁。

sentences.en: So you've got people in their late 50s and early 60s who for the first time face work requirements in order to get SNAP benefits.
sentences.zh: 所以，那些50多岁和60出头的人第一次面临为了获得SNAP福利而必须工作的要求。

sentences.en: But that's not really the main factor in what's driving the caseload declines in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是导致亚利桑那州案件量下降的主要因素。

sentences.en: The thing that's really driving this is a change in how SNAP is funded.
sentences.zh: 真正驱动这一现象的是SNAP资金来源方式的改变。

sentences.en: Historically, the federal government had paid all the benefits.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，联邦政府支付了所有福利。

sentences.en: States paid part of the administrative costs of running a SNAP program, but all the food stamp money came from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 各州支付运行SNAP计划的部分行政费用，但所有的食品券资金都来自联邦政府。

sentences.en: But now this new law says that if a state makes too many mistakes, and we're mostly talking small administrative errors, they'll have to pay up to 15% of the benefits.
sentences.zh: 但现在这项新法律规定，如果一个州犯了太多错误——我们主要指的是小的行政错误——他们就必须承担高达15%的福利费用。

sentences.en: And in some states, that could cost more than a billion dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 在某些州，这每年可能耗资超过10亿美元。

sentences.en: Basically, what the federal government is doing, if I understand this correctly, is telling the states that if they mess up their payments, they're going to end up shouldering
sentences.zh: 基本上，如果我理解得没错，联邦政府所做的是告诉各州，如果他们搞砸了支付，他们最终将不得不承担

sentences.en: part of the cost of this program, and it could be a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 该计划的部分成本，这可能是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're basically saying, if you can't keep what's known as your error rate down, you'll lose access to a bunch of federal money.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在说，如果你不能降低所谓的“错误率”，你就会失去获得大量联邦资金的机会。

sentences.en: So much money that some states may not be able to keep running the program at all.
sentences.zh: 金额之大，以至于一些州可能根本无法继续运行该计划。

sentences.en: I think that's worth stopping to consider for a moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为这值得停下来思考一下。

sentences.en: I mean, can you imagine a state without a food stamp program?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能想象一个没有食品券计划的州吗？

sentences.en: So in order to avoid a $300 million penalty and potentially losing the program altogether,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了避免3亿美元的罚款并可能完全失去该计划，

sentences.en: Arizona officials made dramatic changes to the program, and the rolls instantly began falling.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的官员对该计划进行了剧烈改革，受益人数立即开始下降。

sentences.en: They fell much farther and much faster than Arizona officials imagined.
sentences.zh: 下降的幅度和速度远超亚利桑那州官员的想象。

sentences.en: And what we found in our reporting was that these are people who, by and large, remain eligible for aid, but simply can't get it because they're stuck in webs of red tape.
sentences.zh: 我们在报道中发现，这些人绝大多数仍然符合援助条件，但仅仅因为陷入了官僚主义的泥潭而无法获得援助。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我刚才看到你在打电话。

sentences.zh: 我叫奥利维亚。

sentences.en: I'm here with the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 我正在和人们谈论他们是否收到了SNAP福利。

sentences.en: Oh, girl.
sentences.zh: 噢，姑娘。

sentences.zh: 我什么都做了。

sentences.zh: 还是没有帮助。

sentences.zh: 陷入官僚泥潭的人之一，是我同事奥利维亚·纳特和我在凤凰城一家食品券办公室外遇到的一位女士。

sentences.en: Her name is Alejandra Casillas.
sentences.zh: 她叫亚历杭德拉·卡西利亚斯。

sentences.en: I've been applying since December, right?
sentences.zh: 我从十二月就开始申请了，对吧？

sentences.zh: 我在一月份做了申请。

sentences.en: They had me waiting until February.
sentences.zh: 他们让我等到二月。

sentences.en: I can't be calling them all the time because I have a job and kids to take care of.
sentences.zh: 我不能一直给他们打电话，因为我有工作，还有孩子要照顾。

sentences.en: But yeah, I call them at least five times in the morning.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我早上至少给他们打了五次电话。

sentences.en: She's 28 years old.
sentences.zh: 她今年28岁。

sentences.en: She's a mother of two.
sentences.zh: 她是两个孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: And she's working.
sentences.zh: 而且她在工作。

sentences.en: But she doesn't make enough to feed her family.
sentences.zh: 但她的收入不足以养活家人。

sentences.en: She gave us a version of a story we had heard in other places of notices that were impossible to comply with.
sentences.zh: 她向我们讲述了一个我们在其他地方也听过的故事版本：收到的通知根本无法执行。

sentences.en: Mailing date, you see that.
sentences.zh: 邮寄日期，你看这个。

sentences.en: And it says right here
sentences.zh: 而这里写着

sentences.en: that I have to do the interview by February 28, 2026.
sentences.zh: 我必须在2026年2月28日之前完成面试。

sentences.en: So a month after they said this is the deadline, that's when you got the piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 所以，在他们说这是截止日期一个月后，你才收到这张纸。

sentences.en: I'm like, what am I supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Do I look like I can create a time machine and go back in time?
sentences.zh: 我看起来像能制造时间机器并回到过去的人吗？

sentences.zh: 杰森，为什么她获得福利这么难？

sentences.en: Did she explain that?
sentences.zh: 她解释过吗？

sentences.en: Once you apply for SNAP benefits, you have to have an interview with a special caseworker.
sentences.zh: 一旦你申请SNAP福利，你就必须与专门的个案工作人员进行面试。

sentences.en: And it has to happen within two weeks of the application.
sentences.zh: 而且必须在申请后的两周内完成。

sentences.en: But you call in those two weeks and nobody answers.
sentences.zh: 但你在那两周内打电话，却没人接听。

sentences.en: Nobody answers.
sentences.zh: 没人接听。

sentences.en: And tomorrow is the last day that I have to complete my interview.
sentences.zh: 明天就是我必须完成面试的最后一天了。

sentences.en: And then they close the cases, too.
sentences.zh: 然后他们也会关闭案件。

sentences.en: She couldn't get through on the phone to have the interview.
sentences.zh: 她无法通过电话进行面试。

sentences.en: So she left her home, came in to the SNAP office on her day off, and they told her, you can't do the interview here.
sentences.zh: 所以她离开了家，在休息日来到SNAP办公室，他们却告诉她，你不能在这里面试。

sentences.en: You have to call.
sentences.zh: 你必须打电话。

sentences.en: I can even call it right now, too, and they'll drop it.
sentences.zh: 我现在甚至可以打个电话，他们也会挂断的。

sentences.en: Can we try?
sentences.zh: 我们可以试试吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.zh: 欢迎致电经济安全部

sentences.zh: 家庭援助管理局。

sentences.en: To continue in English, press 1.
sentences.zh: 如需继续使用英语，请按1。

sentences.en: We listen to her make the call.
sentences.zh: 我们听着她拨打了电话。

sentences.en: Our records show you need to complete an interview.
sentences.zh: 我们的记录显示您需要完成一次面试。

sentences.en: Due to extremely high call volumes, we are not able to accept your call.
sentences.zh: 由于通话量极大，我们无法接听您的电话。

sentences.en: We apologize for the inconvenience.
sentences.zh: 对于给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意。

sentences.en: That's how it is all the time that we call.
sentences.zh: 我们每次打电话都是这样。

sentences.en: That call, like others, went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 那通电话和其他电话一样，毫无结果。

sentences.en: They told her she'd just have to wait for a call back.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她只能等回电。

sentences.en: So now here she is in limbo, unable to get access to food stamps.
sentences.zh: 所以现在她处于这种悬而未决的状态，无法获得食品券。

sentences.en: But what really struck me about her was just how angry and defeated she seemed.
sentences.zh: 但她真正让我震撼的是她看起来是多么愤怒和挫败。

sentences.en: She told us she'd been going to food banks, that she'd stopped breastfeeding her child because she feared she lacked nutrients.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们她一直在去食物银行，她已经停止给孩子母乳喂养，因为她担心自己缺乏营养。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: And then she said something really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 然后她说了一件非常惊人的事情。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Like, I will sign up for Instacart as a driver and keep the groceries for my kids.
sentences.zh: 比如，我会注册成为Instacart的送货司机，然后把杂货留给我孩子们。

sentences.en: I'm at that point.
sentences.zh: 我已经到了那个地步了。

sentences.en: You know, she wasn't apologetic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她并没有道歉。

sentences.en: She wasn't defiant.
sentences.zh: 她也没有表现出反抗。

sentences.en: She wasn't justifying it.
sentences.zh: 她也没有为自己辩解。

sentences.en: She was just saying...
sentences.zh: 她只是说……

sentences.en: Then I do think it through.
sentences.zh: 然后我确实仔细想了想。

sentences.en: I'm like, they're pushing me to that point, but my kids need me so I can't be breaking no laws.
